photograph.title: Tryfan
photograph.description: Tryfan. A very popular mountain with climbers.
photograph.author: Tony Edwards
photograph.metadata_provenance: Wikimedia Commons file page and structured data sourced from Geograph image 1308873. Camera/object coordinates and 247 degree heading are published metadata; no independent survey is claimed.

observer.coordinate_provenance: Published Wikimedia/Geograph camera coordinate in WGS84, transformed to EPSG:27700 with PROJ/pyproj; not independently surveyed.
observer.eye_height_provenance: CALIBRATION_ASSUMPTION; photographer tripod/optical height is not published

target.name: Published depicted-place coordinate
target.provenance: Published Wikimedia/Geograph object location, transformed to EPSG:27700 with PROJ/pyproj; not inferred from terrain appearance.

view.bearing_comparison_status: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; depicted-place coordinate is approximate and is not used for primary orientation

pitch_reference.name: Canonical Tryfan summit reference
pitch_reference.provenance: Canonical Meridian Tryfan summit/reference coordinate; confirmed by the Lab 004A source-DTM geographic diagnostic to lie 0.370 degrees from the published heading.
pitch_reference.orientation_role: GEOMETRIC_DIAGNOSTIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; never an automatic photographic pitch target in calibration mode
pitch_reference.height_source: Actual imported Landscape vertical trace at runtime

primary_orientation.horizontal: Published WGS84 geographic heading 247 degrees remains source metadata. MERIDIAN_CAMERA_HEADING_DEGREES may supply a recovered photographic centre heading; it is converted with the established local BNG convergence before mapping to Unreal yaw.
primary_orientation.vertical: Explicit MERIDIAN_CAMERA_PITCH_DEGREES photographic calibration; the runtime Landscape trace to the canonical summit is retained only as a geometric reference

camera_calibration.provenance: UNKNOWN; no usable focal-length or sensor/FOV metadata is published
camera_calibration.uncertainty: 40 degrees is an explicit user-selected starting calibration override. It is not measured or derived from lens metadata.
camera_calibration.pitch_provenance: UNKNOWN; photograph provides no camera pitch metadata
camera_calibration.heading_provenance: Published 247 degree heading is source metadata; any runtime override is a recovered photographic calibration, not measured camera metadata

uncertainties: Camera and object coordinates are published metadata, not independently surveyed positions.
The published 247 degree heading differs from the WGS84 coordinate-derived geodesic bearing by 7.365 degrees.
The photographer optical height is unknown; 1.70 m is an explicit calibration assumption.
Focal length, sensor geometry, crop and FOV are not published; FOV requires visual calibration.
DTM represents bare earth and cannot reproduce transient people, vegetation or structures in the photograph.
The published depicted-place coordinate is retained only as approximate-subject diagnostic provenance and is not used to orient the primary camera.
Horizontal yaw uses the published true heading converted to local BNG grid direction; summit tracing controls pitch only.
Photographic pitch is not published and must be supplied explicitly as MERIDIAN_CAMERA_PITCH_DEGREES; the summit-derived pitch is diagnostic only.
The recovered 253.55 degree centre heading is a source-DTM skyline calibration; published heading 247 degrees remains the original metadata.

derived_terrain_expectations.surface: Canonical Lab 004 DTM R16, bilinear at transformed BNG coordinate
derived_terrain_expectations.status: SUMMIT PITCH IS A DERIVED GEOMETRIC REFERENCE; PHOTOGRAPHIC PITCH AND HFOV ARE EXPLICIT CALIBRATION PARAMETERS; CAMERA AND SUMMIT HEIGHTS ARE RETRACED FROM THE IMPORTED LANDSCAPE AT RUNTIME
